description: Backend: the complete formShares API surface plus its integrations. Create the access helpers, the formShares schemas/service/routes and the invites routes; add the two email templates; wire the FORM_SHARED notification type; integrate the OR-fallback effective-access into form.service.ts WITHOUT weakening workspace checks; register the routers and the SHARE_NOT_FOUND error code in app.ts. One coherent backend unit — it builds and typechecks as a whole. Depends on FEAT-001 (needs the regenerated Prisma client with FormShare/enums/FORM_SHARED). Must come before FEAT-003, which consumes this API shape.
steps: Create c:\Qivo\apps\api\src\modules\formShares\formShare.access.ts exporting getAcceptedShareRole(formId,userId), hasEditorShare(formId,userId), hasResponseViewShare(formId,userId) exactly per design.md's 'Effective access resolution' helpers: all filter status:"ACCEPTED"; hasEditorShare matches role EDITOR; hasResponseViewShare matches EDITOR or VIEWER; getAcceptedShareRole returns the highest capability or null. Use the prisma singleton from ../../db/prisma.js.

Create c:\Qivo\apps\api\src\modules\formShares\formShare.schemas.ts with `createShareSchema = z.object({ email: z.string().trim().email().max(200), role: z.enum(["RESPONDER","EDITOR","VIEWER"]) })` (mirror member.schemas.ts).

Create c:\Qivo\apps\api\src\modules\formShares\formShare.service.ts implementing requireFormEditor, listShares, createShare, revokeShare, getInviteByToken, acceptInvite, listSharedWithMe exactly per design.md's 'Service' section: email always lowercased; share token via randomBytes(32).toString("hex") from node:crypto; createShare uses an explicit findUnique({ where:{ formId_email:{ formId, email } } }) then create-or-update (NOT prisma.upsert), OMITTING token on the update branch so an outstanding invite link keeps working, and auto-ACCEPT+link only when PENDING and targetUser exists; side effects fired as `void <promise>.catch(console.error)` (sendFormShareInviteEmail / sendFormShareExistingUserEmail / createNotification) with the pinned title/message literals from design.md (title="Form shared with you", message=`${inviterName} gave you ${roleLabel} access to "${formTitle}".`); getInviteByToken returns only the minimal public projection { formTitle, role, inviterName, status }; acceptInvite enforces user.email.toLowerCase() === share.email (throw FORBIDDEN on mismatch), is idempotent for the same user, and throws INVALID_TOKEN for unknown/used-by-another; listSharedWithMe returns ACCEPTED+linked shares regardless of role. Add error helpers including a new SHARE_NOT_FOUND tagged Error.

Add two exported functions to c:\Qivo\apps\api\src\services\email.ts: sendFormShareInviteEmail(to, { inviterName, formTitle, role, token }) linking to `${WEB_URL}/signup?invite=<token>`, and sendFormShareExistingUserEmail(to, { inviterName, formTitle, role, slug, formId }) linking by role (EDITOR -> /forms/<formId>/edit, VIEWER -> /forms/<formId>/responses, RESPONDER -> /f/<slug>). Match sendTeamInviteEmail style (layout()+button()+await sendEmail), use getWebUrl(), and a local roleLabel/roleVerb map. No env changes.

Edit c:\Qivo\apps\api\src\modules\notifications\notification.service.ts: add FORM_SHARED to the local NotificationType union AND add a FORM_SHARED entry to BOTH the messages ("A form was shared with you.") and titles ("Form shared with you") maps in notifyFormEvent so the Record<NotificationType,string> typing stays exhaustive.

Edit c:\Qivo\apps\api\src\modules\forms\form.service.ts: import the access helpers and add the OR-fallback to getEditableForm (hasEditorShare), getForm (gated to hasResponseViewShare ONLY — RESPONDER must not load the editor read; do NOT use getAcceptedShareRole!==null here), getFormForResponseAccess (hasResponseViewShare), and restructure updateForm to a single non-VIEWER-member query plus a hasEditorShare fallback that runs whenever that query yields no form (covering both non-member and VIEWER-member cases), exactly per design.md. Leave deleteForm and publishForm workspace-only. Do NOT change the export visibility of any of these functions.

Create c:\Qivo\apps\api\src\modules\formShares\formShare.routes.ts (default export formShareRouter, all requireAuth) declaring `GET /shared-with-me` FIRST, then `POST /:formId/shares` (201, createShareSchema.parse), `GET /:formId/shares`, `DELETE /:formId/shares/:shareId`. Follow the member.routes.ts handler shape (401 guard, param string checks, {success:true,data}, catch->next).

Create c:\Qivo\apps\api\src\modules\formShares\invite.routes.ts (default export inviteRouter): `GET /:token` public (NO requireAuth) -> getInviteByToken, `POST /:token/accept` with requireAuth -> acceptInvite. No csrf.ts change is needed (verify by reading csrf.ts: GET is a safe method, accept is Bearer).

Edit c:\Qivo\apps\api\src\app.ts: import formShareRouter and inviteRouter; add `app.use("/api/forms", formShareRouter);` BEFORE the existing `app.use("/api/forms", formRouter);`; add `app.use("/api/invites", inviteRouter);`; add a `case "SHARE_NOT_FOUND":` returning 404 with code SHARE_NOT_FOUND to the errorHandler switch.
acceptance_criteria: `pnpm --filter api exec tsc --noEmit` passes with the new module, email, notification, form.service, and app.ts edits.
formShareRouter is mounted BEFORE formRouter on /api/forms and declares /shared-with-me first (so it cannot be swallowed by /:formId).
csrf.ts is unchanged and GET /api/invites/:token + POST /api/invites/:token/accept are reachable (GET safe method, accept Bearer-exempt).
app.ts errorHandler has a SHARE_NOT_FOUND -> 404 branch.

getForm's share fallback is gated to hasResponseViewShare only (RESPONDER cannot load the editor read); updateForm's fallback covers the non-member EDITOR-share case; deleteForm/publishForm remain workspace-only.
verification: Run `pnpm --filter api exec tsc --noEmit` and confirm it passes.
Run `pnpm build:api` and confirm it compiles.

Read c:\Qivo\apps\api\src\app.ts and confirm formShareRouter is registered before formRouter and the SHARE_NOT_FOUND case exists; read formShare.routes.ts and confirm /shared-with-me is declared first.
findings:
Done. Backend complete, verified: `pnpm --filter api exec tsc --noEmit` = exit 0, `pnpm build:api` = exit 0. app.ts mounts formShareRouter BEFORE formRouter on /api/forms (so /shared-with-me wins over /:formId), mounts inviteRouter at /api/invites, and has a new SHARE_NOT_FOUND->404 case (placed right after FORM_NOT_FOUND). formShare.routes.ts declares GET /shared-with-me FIRST. csrf.ts was NOT changed (verified: GET is a safe method and is let through; POST accept is Bearer and Bearer is exempt).

Files created: apps/api/src/modules/formShares/{formShare.access.ts, formShare.schemas.ts, formShare.service.ts, formShare.routes.ts, invite.routes.ts}. Files edited: apps/api/src/services/email.ts (two new templates), apps/api/src/modules/notifications/notification.service.ts (FORM_SHARED added to union + both messages/titles maps), apps/api/src/modules/forms/form.service.ts (OR-fallbacks), apps/api/src/app.ts (router mounts + error case).

Implementation notes for later steps: createShare uses explicit findUnique({where:{formId_email:{formId,email}}}) then create-or-update (NOT upsert); token OMITTED on the update branch (outstanding invite link preserved); email lowercased; token via randomBytes(32).toString('hex'); side effects all `void <promise>.catch(console.error)`; pinned notification title='Form shared with you', message=`${inviterName} gave you ${roleLabel} access to "${formTitle}".`. acceptInvite enforces user.email.toLowerCase()===share.email (FORBIDDEN on mismatch), idempotent for same user, INVALID_TOKEN for unknown/used-by-another. getForm fallback is gated to hasResponseViewShare ONLY (RESPONDER cannot load editor read). updateForm restructured to single non-VIEWER-member query + hasEditorShare fallback covering both non-member and VIEWER-member. deleteForm/publishForm left workspace-only. No export-visibility changes.

EXACT ENDPOINT RESPONSE SHAPES for FEAT-003 (frontend). All wrapped in {success:true,data:{...}}:
- POST /api/forms/:formId/shares (201) -> { share } where share is the FormShare row INCLUDING user: { id,name,email,avatarUrl } | null. Full share fields: { id, formId, email, userId, role, status, token, invitedById, createdAt, acceptedAt, user }. (NOTE: the raw share row DOES include `token` in this create/list response — frontend should ignore it, do not display.)
- GET /api/forms/:formId/shares -> { shares: FormShare[] } (same shape as above, ordered createdAt asc, each with user include).
- DELETE /api/forms/:formId/shares/:shareId -> { message: 'Share revoked.' }.
- GET /api/forms/shared-with-me -> { shares: Array<{ shareId, role, form: { id, title, slug, status } }> } (ordered acceptedAt desc). Matches the SharedWithMeItem type in design.md.
- GET /api/invites/:token (PUBLIC) -> { invite: { formTitle, role, inviterName, status } } (minimal projection; no email/userId/token leaked). Matches InvitePreview type.
- POST /api/invites/:token/accept (Bearer) -> { formId, slug, role }. Role-based redirect: EDITOR->/forms/<formId>/edit, VIEWER->/forms/<formId>/responses, RESPONDER->/f/<slug>.

Error codes the frontend branches on (ApiRequestError.code): FORBIDDEN (403, email mismatch on accept OR not a form editor on manage), INVALID_TOKEN (400, unknown/used invite), FORM_NOT_FOUND (404), SHARE_NOT_FOUND (404), VALIDATION_ERROR (400, bad email/role).

Email links (sendFormShareExistingUserEmail) use /forms/<formId>/edit (EDITOR), /forms/<formId>/responses (VIEWER), /f/<slug> (RESPONDER); sendFormShareInviteEmail (new user) links to <WEB_URL>/signup?invite=<token>.
